info.name: FoC D2 Demo (User + Supplier via Gateway)
info.description:
AI-influenced: authored with OpenCode (Claude Opus); see ai/usage-log.md.

Milestone D2 demo of the User Service and Supplier Service exercised end-to-end through the API Gateway (http://localhost:8080), no UI. Folders 00-07 are ordered as the demo runs; run them top to bottom. Every request has a test asserting the expected status code (and key body fields) and chains tokens/ids through environment variables. Auth is set per-request (Bearer {{adminToken}} or {{clientToken}}) so the acting role is explicit.

Manual OTP: with OTP_DEV_MODE=true the user-service logs the code (line 'OTP_DEV_MODE active: verification code for ...'). Read it from `docker compose logs user-service`, set the `otpCode` environment variable, then continue folder 01. See postman/README.md for the two newman run modes.
